description: A requested attribute named dynamic is given, and dynamic blocks are still expanded
notes: The README makes dynamic a special block type in the bodies it expands, and the spec makes a schema that requests a block type whose name is also an attribute name an error, without saying what happens when a schema requests an attribute named dynamic. hashicorp/hcl adds the block type dynamic to the schema without checking it (expandBody.extendSchema in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), and the native syntax keeps attributes and blocks apart (see native/structure/schema-attribute-and-block-type-same-name), so it gives the attribute and expands the dynamic block.
